page.notes: The scan is too small and blurred to transcribe the two columns reliably. Only the page number and running head are read with confidence. The Latin column begins "Cum enim vel quantalibet grauitate capput tentatur; aut ex somno, aut temulentia..." and the Greek column (right) is a commentary on Aristotle's De Partibus/De Generatione passage on bones, nerves, hair and nails. Marginal letters A, B, C, D, E, F appear between the columns. Individual words could not be read with certainty, so the body text is not transcribed here.
